component.name: Hey Whisper
component.summary: Capture spoken voice notes and transcribe them into weekly markdown logs

description.p: Hey Whisper is a lightweight speech-to-text note-taking tool powered by faster-whisper. It captures audio from your default microphone and generates clean, weekly markdown logs separated by day headers and timestamped entries.

ul.li: Push-to-talk transcription hotkey (held-down key or click)
Left-side interactive notes tree grouped by month
Built-in markdown editor and rendered reader
